title: Famous Door again, Red Norvo and Joe Bushkin
summary: After a tape change, Roy recalls the Famous Door arrangement of feeding the band upstairs, Red Norvo and young Joe Bushkin.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We stopped at... We were talking about the Famous Door, and the fact that they sort of kept you under wraps there. You opened early in the evening, and then they'd take you upstairs and feed you and so forth...
When there were people in the joint, nobody got to hear you.
It was almost like the Last Supper! We were treated very nice, I mean, but we still wanted to play, you know.

Yeah! Also Joe Bushkin was working there. That's when he first came on the scene. He was a sixteen-year-old kid or something like that. We used to kind of look out for him, you know. But they really snafued us. Then when everybody would go home, then they'd bring us back out. Which maybe some guys would like that, but we wanted to play. We had a good little group, you know. But that's the story of my life. Heh-heh.
So how long did that last for?
I think we was there about two weeks; as far as I can remember, about two weeks.
